summary: Split from MPI-462. The orphan collector shipped local-only; the remote uninstall branch returns before it. Needs _remoteSharedDepIds + a volume inventory, and a live Pod to verify before any deletion code aims at a user's volume.

brief.md added so a cold agent can pick this up: what to mirror from the local sweep, the volume-inventory piece that has no local analogue, every refusal to copy, and the do-not-lower bar (a live Pod, read-only classification first - MPI-310 destroyed 5.24GB changing this guard).

todo -> doing. Picked up to build the REMOTE orphan sweep. Shape settled from the code: protection map is _remoteSharedDepIds(null) (it already accepts a null exclusion - same MODELS.filter / _inFlightDepIds(null) / _pluginRequiredDepIds(null) path the local twin uses with null), orphan classification reuses _orphanedDepIds unchanged (a Set answers .has the same as a Map), and the volume inventory needs NO new wrapper endpoint - remoteModelsCheck already accepts a pseudo-model, which is exactly how the reconciler asks about a bare dep list at downloadManager.js:1904.

Code complete and unit-verified; maturity in-progress -> validating. _sweepOrphanedDepsRemote lands in routes/downloadManager.js and is wired into the remote uninstall branch (gated on deleteFiles, never fatal, swept N orphaned on the same log line, sweptOrphans on the same response and download:uninstalled payload as local). Three things the card asked for turned out to need NO new machinery: _remoteSharedDepIds already took a null exclusion, _orphanedDepIds was reusable unchanged because a Set answers .has like a Map, and the volume inventory needed no wrapper endpoint - remoteModelsCheck takes a pseudo-model, the same trick _reconcileOutstandingRemoteDeps uses. One refusal the local sweep does NOT need was found and added: bakedOnPod engineAssets (7 of them) live in the Pod image, so _isImageResident makes remoteModelsCheck report them installed while the wrapper cannot delete them. tests/orphan-sweep-remote.test.cjs 5/5 and npm test 477/477. NOT closable - the bar is a live Pod with a read-only classification read first; recipe in validation.md.
